blurb: Visitors drive the one-way 5.5-mile Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail starting at the end of Cherokee Orchard Road. The trail features numbered stops with nature views, waterfalls, and historic homesteads. A booklet with information about the nature and history is available for purchase on the honor system at the trail start.
